correctness.rationale: For an n-site uniform reflected path, the simple Laplacian spectrum makes the derivative a sum of at most n-1 distinct real exponentials, so the Chebyshev zero bound forbids two strict interior peaks for n<=4. For n=5 the embedded exact-Fraction uniformization script certifies four strict derivative signs for each q=95,97, tight brackets around both maxima and opposite peak orderings. Affine dependence carries signs to every q in [95,97]. P14 derivative has a double zero at origin, positive slowest spectral mode at infinity, and at most three zeros counting multiplicities; therefore P14 is strictly increasing, proving a unique peak-height crossing. Boundary values establish globality. All checks were rerun from the embedded script.

value.rationale: The exact minimal five-lane threshold and uniquely tied separated global mixing rates are structural behavior of one fixed finite-horizon ecological delivery objective, not a routine alteration of a single transport coefficient. They expose a genuine nonconvexity and possible management-choice ambiguity when heterogeneous nursery quality interacts with transverse dispersal. They motivate checking multiple mixing regimes rather than assuming monotone improvements, while correctly making no field-calibrated prediction.
